name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Analytics Implementation & Marketing Technology Specialist | Google Tag Manager, GA4, Conversion Tracking, Multi-Client Agency Operations
summary: Marketing technology operator who installs, configures, and maintains the tracking and data plumbing behind client marketing programs. At Solenzo I deploy Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every client site, connect forms and ad traffic to the CRM through webhooks and APIs, and validate that the data lands where it should. Agency background across Level Agency and Fetch & Funnel managing several client accounts at once, with working SQL (BigQuery/GA4), and 18 published articles explaining tracking, schema, and attribution to non-technical readers.
